Compute BR-to-Intan Shifts

Script: preprocessing_scripts/compute_br_to_intan_shifts.py

Computes the timeshift between the Intan and Blackrock recordings.

Steps

  1. Load metadata to match Intan files to BR files.

  2. Load template sent from BR to Intan and the Intan ADC file.

  3. Match the template to the BR template signal.

  4. Save shifts, adjusted shifts, and related information to data_root/location/Metadata/br_to_intan_shifts.csv.
